# many-tags

Ships every release as its own tag.

## Install

```sh
ocx pull tools/many-tags@latest
ocx run tools/many-tags -- --help
```

## Highlights

- Ships as a single static binary.
- Pinned by digest, never by moving tag.
- Reads configuration from the environment.

| Platform | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| linux/amd64 | yes |
| darwin/arm64 | yes |

See the [project page](https://example.com/tools/many-tags) for details.
